messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — Sprinter spotlight interview scheduled for Thurs 10:00am PT with their Head of ML. Need the following before we record:
- Final quote approval from product & legal by Wed EOD
- Signed release form (Ellie?)
- One-pager of approved benchmark wording (Kai)
- Any screenshots/assets from Sprinter (Sam)

Jake Patel: Got it. I'll draft two quote options: short tagline + a metrics line. Can we push the metrics line to legal for wording? e.g., "reduced inference cost by ~40%" or "cut per-token cost by 40%" — which is safer?

Ellie Rivera: Please send the exact phrasing and the source of the metric (internal report or customer-provided). I need the transcript and the raw numbers to verify. No PHI in screenshots. I'll aim to review release + quote by Wed noon.

Sam Okafor: We can pull the benchmark report and the p50/p95 latency numbers. There are screenshots from the dashboard, but Sprinter needs to approve screenshots with any customer identifiers removed. I'll coordinate with their PM.

Kai Nakamura: For the one-pager: let's avoid absolute dollar claims. Prefer relative statements and include the test conditions: model (Llama-2-13b), sequence length 512, batching config. I can spin a short bench blurb and share as a Google doc.

Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll compile a doc with the quote options + bench blurb + release form link. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/sprinter-spotlight-draft (placeholder)

Clara (ops-bot): Reminder set: review due Wed 12:00. 

Jake Patel: Quick question — can we use the customer's logo in the post? Sprinter legal said yes in principle but requires a logo usage file. Sam, can you request the high-res logo and the trademark contact?

Sam Okafor: On it. Reaching out to Sprinter PM now. ETA 24h.

Ellie Rivera: Also: if the quote references an internal metric, we need a short attribution line: "according to Sprinter's internal benchmark". If it's our measurement, say "according to Redwood Inference benchmarks". Which one is it?

Jake Patel: It's a joint result — Sprinter validation of our benchmark runs. I'll mark it as "Sprinter validation of Redwood Inference benchmarks" as a compromise.

Kai Nakamura: Suggest adding a small methods footnote in the blog and the one-pager so we don't get asked follow-ups. Something like: "Benchmark run details: model family, tokenization, seq len, batch size, quantization profile. See appendix."

Maria Chen: Perfect. Plan for Wed:
- Morning: final quote + legal sign-off (Ellie)
- Noon: Sprinter logo + assets received (Sam)
- Afternoon: final blog + one-pager locked, send to Sprinter for final OK
- Thu 10am: record interview (remote)

Clara (ops-bot): Calendar invite sent to everyone tagged.

Jake Patel: I'll prepare a 30s soundbite for the recording and a list of three guided questions.

Ellie Rivera: Once I get the draft I'll add any redlines inline. Quick heads up: we normally ask for 7 business days on trademark approvals but logos for co-marketing are usually faster.

Sam Okafor: Sprinter PM replied: they can provide logo + marketing contact within 24 hours and will review final draft by Thu morning.

Maria Chen: Awesome — thanks team. I'll post the compiled doc in this thread when the draft is ready. :thumbsup:

Jake Patel: Sounds good. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

Ellie Rivera: +1.

Maria Chen: Draft uploaded: https://docs.google.com/sprinter-spotlight-draft-v2 (please review)

Sam Okafor: Saw it, adding screenshots and the benchmark export.

Kai Nakamura: Reviewed methods section, made a small tweak to quantization wording.

Ellie Rivera: I left two small redlines on the quote wording. Maria, once you choose option A or B I can approve the final language.

Maria Chen: Choosing option B (metrics line + attribution). Sending to Ellie now for final sign-off.

Ellie Rivera: Approved. Signed release attached.

Maria Chen: All approvals in place — moving to asset production and scheduling the recording. Thanks all :party_popper:
